source: 关闭功能暂时停用。可在白名单页恢复默认规则；原配置会备份。
en: Closing is temporarily disabled. Restore the default rules on the Whitelist page; the existing file will be backed up.

source: 更新于 {0:HH:mm:ss}  |  本机只读采集
启动来源：父进程已退出或无法核实
en: Parent has exited or could not be verified

source: {0} 个程序 | {1} 个进程 | {2} 条保留规则
| {0} 个系统 / 服务进程已隐藏
单击左侧程序展开进程，再选中进程查看详情。
en: Expand an app on the left, then select a process to view its details.

source: （另 {0} 个系统 / 服务已隐藏）
未加入白名单，可在确认后关闭
en: Not whitelisted; can close after confirmation

source: 一个程序可以包含多个进程。主界面、网页渲染、崩溃报告、后台服务可能分别运行。列表按可核实的程序身份分组；没有足够证据的程序保持独立。
en: An app can use separate processes for its interface, web content, crash reports and services. Processes are grouped by verified app identity. Those without enough evidence stay separate.

source: 连线表示父进程启动了子进程，启动时间先后顺序已核对。它不能单独证明两个进程属于同一软件；树中只展示当前程序内的启动关系。
en: A connection means the parent started the child, with start times checked. It does not prove they belong to the same app. This tree only includes processes within the selected app.

source: 当前快照没有可核实的跨程序启动关系。父进程可能已经退出。
en: No verified links to other apps in this snapshot. The parent may have exited.

source: 文件版本信息由程序自行声明，不等于验证过的数字签名。未知或无法读取的信息不会补猜。
en: File version details are declared by the app, not verified digital signatures. Unavailable information is left unknown.

source: {0}（父 PID 已复用或时间未知，不能确认关联）
en: {0} (PID reused or start time unknown; relationship unverified)

source: 无可读取标题的顶层窗口
en: No top-level window with a readable title

source: 请在白名单页恢复默认规则，再进行修改。
en: Restore the default rules on the Whitelist page before making changes.

source: 程序身份（从程序列表添加）
安装目录（保留整个目录内程序）
同时保留由它启动的子进程
进程名规则会匹配所有同名进程。目录规则覆盖该目录及其子目录。包含子进程会扩大保留范围。
en: Process-name rules match every process with that name. Folder rules include subfolders. Including child processes broadens protection.

source: 文件选择器不可用，可手动填写完整路径：
en: File picker unavailable. Enter the full path manually:

source: 请填写规则名称和匹配值。
en: Enter a rule name and match value.

source: 程序身份请在运行程序列表中勾选添加，或选择另外一种匹配方式。
en: Add app-identity rules from the running apps list, or choose another match type.

source: 恢复空白名单会停用当前自定义规则。
en: Restoring an empty whitelist deactivates the current custom rules.

source: 已恢复默认白名单，原配置已备份。
en: Default whitelist restored; previous configuration backed up.

source: 分享给其他电脑（仅通用程序身份）
en: Share with another PC (portable app identities only)

source: 完整备份（包含本机路径与名称规则）
en: Full backup (includes local paths and process names)

source:
分享模式可导出 {0} 条通用规则，省略 {1} 条依赖本机路径、进程名称或未知身份的规则。对方没有或未运行的软件只会显示未匹配。

完整备份包含本机盘符和目录；导入其他电脑时，需要先核对才能启用这些规则。
en:
Sharing exports {0} portable rules and omits {1} rules tied to local paths, process names or unknown identities. Apps missing or not running on the other PC simply remain unmatched.

A full backup includes local drives and folders. Review these rules before enabling them on another PC.

source: 没有可分享的通用规则
本机路径和单独进程名不会自动转换为跨电脑规则。可以导出完整备份，由接收方核对后启用。
en: Local paths and process-name rules cannot be converted automatically. Export a full backup so the recipient can review and enable them.

source: 合并到现有规则（相同规则保留现有设置）
en: Merge with current rules (keep existing settings for matches)

source:
{0}

en:
{0}
Validated {1} rules. The {2} rules tied to local paths, names or unknown identities are disabled by default. Missing or stopped apps stay unmatched; nothing is installed or launched.

Local rule; review on another PC

source: 替换会移除未包含在文件中的保留规则。确认前请检查范围。当前配置会自动保留一份 .bak 备份。
en: Replacing removes rules that are absent from this file. Review the scope before confirming. A .bak copy of your current configuration will be saved.

en: Force remaining processes to exit after 5 seconds

source: 强制结束可能丢失未保存的内容。未勾选时，只发送正常关闭请求，后台无窗口进程可能继续运行。
en: Forcing an exit may lose unsaved work. Without this option, only normal close requests are sent; background processes without windows may remain running.

source: 同时停止 MyDockFinder 的 MyDock 后台服务
en: Also stop the MyDockFinder MyDock service

source: 需要管理员权限；只停止此服务，不修改开机设置。
en: Requires administrator access. Stops this service without changing startup settings.

{0} 项完成，{1} 项未关闭或已跳过。详情见操作记录。

source: 把需要的程序留下，规则由你决定。

source: 每次更改和关闭，即时记录。

source:
包含背景材质、颜色主题、排序、筛选、系统进程显示和实时刷新选项。

en:
Includes language, background material, theme, sorting, filters, system-process visibility and live refresh.

Sharing includes {0} portable rules and omits {1} local rules. A full backup includes all {2} rules.

Logs, search text, process snapshots and cache files are excluded.
